notice.title: Legal notice
notice.lead: General information about the owner of this website and the terms of use, as required by Spanish Law 34/2002 on information society services and electronic commerce.

sections.title: Purpose and acceptance
sections.body: This website exists to describe the taxi services I offer and to let you request a journey. By using it you accept these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the booking form.

sections.title: How a booking works
sections.body: Sending the form creates a request, not a locked-in booking. The system automatically checks whether the time fits the rest of the schedule and, if it does, I confirm it. A booking is only firm once I have received the request and confirmed it by email, WhatsApp or phone.
items: If you do not receive a confirmation, call the contact number to make sure.
To cancel or change the time, call or write as early as you can.
If you are not at the pickup point, the trip out to meet you may be charged at the official fare.

sections.title: Fares
sections.body: The price of the journey is metered according to the official fares approved by the competent authority, plus any applicable supplements. Any amounts shown on this website are indicative and do not replace the official fare. You can always ask for a receipt.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: The text, design and images on this website belong to its owner or are used with permission. They may not be reproduced or reused for commercial purposes without written authorisation.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: I aim to keep the information on this website accurate and up to date, but I cannot guarantee that it is free of errors or that the service will be available without interruption. Time and route estimates are based on third-party traffic data and may vary.

sections.title: Data protection
sections.body: How I handle the personal data you give me when booking is explained in the privacy policy.

sections.title: Applicable law and complaints
sections.body: These terms are governed by Spanish law. If you are a consumer, you keep the right to bring a claim before the courts where you live. Official complaint forms are available on request.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Here is exactly what data I ask for when you book a taxi, why I need it, who I share it with and how you can stay in control of it.

sections.title: Who handles your data
sections.body: The data controller is the owner of this website, identified in the legal notice. You can get in touch about any privacy matter using the email address or phone number listed there.

sections.title: What data I handle
sections.body: I only ask for what I need to come and get you and complete the journey:
items: Name and phone number, to identify you and be able to reach you.
Email address, if you provide one, to send you the confirmation.
Pickup and drop-off address, plus the date and time of the journey.
Number of passengers and suitcases, to check they fit in the car.
Flight number, if you are going to or coming from the airport, so I can adjust the time if the flight is delayed.
Any notes you add and the language you booked in.

sections.title: Why I need it
sections.body: I handle this data to arrange and provide the transport service you have asked for, which is the performance of the contract between us. The confirmation email is part of that same service. If you send me your email without booking, I only use it to reply to you.
items: Providing the taxi service and contacting you before the journey.
Meeting the tax and accounting obligations that come with taking payment.
Answering questions and handling complaints.

sections.title: Automated availability check
sections.body: When you pick a time, the system uses traffic data to work out whether I can reach the pickup point in time and whether the slot overlaps another journey. If it does not fit, it asks you to choose another time. This is a scheduling check, not a profile of you: if you think it has got it wrong, call me and I will look at it myself.

sections.title: Who I share it with
sections.body: I do not sell or pass on your data. To make the booking work I use these providers, acting as data processors:
items: Supabase, to host the bookings database.
Google Maps, to calculate the route, the live-traffic travel time and the route map.
Resend, to send confirmation emails.
A mobile push notification service, to alert me when a new booking arrives.

sections.title: How long I keep it
sections.body: I keep journey data for as long as it is needed to provide the service and deal with any complaint. Data tied to a payment is kept for the periods required by tax and accounting rules. After that it is deleted or anonymised.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can write to me at any time to exercise the rights the General Data Protection Regulation gives you:
items: Access the data I hold about you and get a copy of it.
Correct it if it is wrong or incomplete.
Ask me to delete it once it is no longer needed.
Restrict or object to the way it is processed.
Receive it in a portable format.
Lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency if you believe your rights have not been respected.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This website uses no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies. The only thing stored in your browser is a technical preference remembering which language you want to read the site in. Because there are no third-party cookies and no profiling, no consent banner is needed; if I ever add any, I will ask you first.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Data is transmitted encrypted and stored in services with restricted access. Only I, as the driver, can view bookings from my app.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: If I change the way I handle data, I will update this page along with the last-updated date shown at the top.
